in_sanskrit.name: गणेश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: गणनात (Gananat) - From the Gana (group), ईश (Ish) - Lord; The Lord of the group, The One who removes obstacles

in_hindi.name: गणेश
in_hindi.long_meaning: गणनात (Gananat) - From the Gana (group), ईश (Ish) - Lord; The Lord of the group, The One who removes obstacles

in_tamil.name: கணேஷ
in_tamil.long_meaning: கஞ்சில் (Kancil) - Goer, Mover, எஷ் (Esh) - Lord; The Lord who goes, The One who removes obstacles

in_telugu.name: గెణేశ
in_telugu.long_meaning: గెణేశ్యుదు (Ganeshvudu) - The One who is the Goer, The One who moves, The One who removes obstacles

in_marathi.name: Ganes
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Beginnings
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ganes हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The one who brings prosperity, wisdom, and removes obstacles

in_bengali.name: Ganes
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of Beginnings
in_bengali.long_meaning: Ganes একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The one who brings prosperity, wisdom, and removes obstacles
